body:
Greg's word (relayed by Fable2 #6809, source 588693a8 #2049, 2026-11-18): no tests that act like benchmarks in the test suite. They move to a Benchmark run that keeps its results; finish the sync first, improve after.
Working rule from now, for new work and reviews:
(1) no NEW test whose pass or fail rests on wall-clock duration, throughput or a timing deadline;
(2) performance fixes prove themselves with deterministic counts (operations, lock-held work, rows touched), not elapsed time.
Bounded waits for an event are fine. The existing suite stays as it is until after sync; the move is filed as w-a04c88d77f6c.
Opus2 (integration owner) adds rules (1) and (2) to every review-pair GO brief. Example: w-ee1cc0cf84bf's bounded-work regression must count records touched, not time.
